text:
maria: spotted a staging CLI session token in a sourcemap while debugging, pasted redacted snippet below
maria: log line -> `Authorization: Bearer stg_cli_abcd1234xxxxxxx` (redacted)
sec-bot: Alert: token-exposure-detection matched pattern `stg_cli_` - severity: medium
aj: oncall - can you paste exact log lines but redact the last 6 chars? don't post full token here
maria: redacted: `Authorization: Bearer stg_cli_abcd1234xxxxxx`
sophia: which env? just staging?
maria: staging-eu, bucket: app-staging, timestamp: 2026-03-19T22:05Z
oliver: immediate: 1) rotate token 2) invalidate existing token via admin API 3) check audit logs for any usage
aj: following runbook, starting invalidate + rotate now
aj: command run -> `curl -X POST https://admin.internal/tokens/invalidate -d '{"id":"stg-cli-1234","force":true}'`
sec-bot: webhook: token invalidation succeeded (actor: aj) at 2298765440
devops: confirm no prod exposure - check RBAC scope for `ingest-staging-cli` role
sophia: IAM shows role `ingest-staging-cli` scoped to staging buckets only, no prod access
maria: do we need to notify any customers? token is internal ingest, not a customer key
oliver: still audit for last 72h to be safe - check for any cross-env requests
aj: query run -> `SELECT * FROM audit.events WHERE token_id='stg-cli-1234' AND ts > now() - interval '72 hours'` -> results: 3 PUTs to staging-batch endpoint
maria: those PUTs map to CI runner id 879; looks like a CI job printed the token into generated sourcemap artifact
aj: created incident ticket INC-2026-88 and assigned to ci-team to remove token from build artifacts and rotate job secret
aj: ticket link: https://internal/inc/INC-2026-88
devops: action items: rotate CI job secret, add secret in KMS, and ensure build pipeline does not embed secrets in sourcemaps
sophia: post-incident prevention: add linter to strip tokens from sourcemaps, enforce `--sourcemap-strip-secrets` in build configs
oliver: propose RBAC change: deny read access to sourcemap storage for token-scoped roles; plus move tokens to KMS-wrapped environment variables
maria: also enable audit-forwarding for token events to SIEM (for correlation)
aj: updating runbook to include KMS checks and key-rotation guidance; will add step to revoke fallback keys too
devops: prevention PR plan: pre-commit hook to block secrets, CI policy check, nightly git-secret scan. I'll draft PR and tag infra-review
maria: customer comms: none required, no customer tokens impacted
sophia: owners: maria (detection + coord), aj (runbook + rotation), devops (prevention PR), oliver (RBAC/KMS follow-up)
maria: short timeline: detected 2026-03-19T22:05Z, invalidated 22:07Z, CI job secret rotated 22:20Z
aj: added timeline + links to #incidents and INC-2026-88
sec-bot: note: added audit tag `exposure:staging-cli` to related events
oliver: follow-up: schedule RBAC review next week and add automated sourcemap scanning to nightly jobs
maria: closing note: thanks all — I'll mark incident as contained. Will reopen if any anomalous usage shows up. :thumbsup:
